title: Greek Hazelnut Gyro Wraps
description: A delicious twist on the classic Greek gyro, featuring crispy phyllo pastry, savory lamb, and crunchy hazelnuts.
instructions: Cut phyllo pastry into 4-6 pieces, depending on desired wrap size.
Brush each piece with olive oil and fold in half.
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy.
Meanwhile, cook lamb gyro meat in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces as it cooks.
Add chopped hazelnuts to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Warm pita bread by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Assemble wraps by spreading a layer of Greek yogurt on the bottom, followed by a few pieces of lamb gyro meat, some chopped cucumber, tomato, and red onion, and finally a sprinkle of feta cheese.
Note: Traditionally, gyro meat is cooked on a vertical spit and served in a warm pita with tomato, onion, cucumber, and tzatziki sauce. This recipe is a simplified version of this classic dish.
